canonicalCaptureStandard.note: The approved production capture standard is not complete. Unknown fields are preserved as unresolved and block visual/geometric matching.

classificationPolicy.geometricMatchingRule: Only CONSISTENT or CONSISTENT_WITH_NOTES visual records may become geometric matching inputs after production verification. All current records are blocked.
classificationPolicy.recaptureQueueRule: Only material inconsistencies that block visual/geometric comparison are queued. Context-only and presentation-only evidence remains comparison-limited without a material recapture item.
